rules.name: xml-escape-by-hand
rules.description: escape XML with paged_fmt::xml (escape_text, escape_attr, escape_attr_with and a format's AttrEscape settings; paged_ooxml::xml re-exports it) or @paged-media/helpers, not a replace chain or a match

rules.name: content-types-by-hand
rules.description: write and patch [Content_Types].xml with paged_ooxml::content_types

rules.name: roman-numerals
rules.description: number with paged_model::roman (InDesign's forms, past 3999)

rules.name: srgb-transfer
rules.description: convert sRGB and linear light with paged_color::math
rules.allowReason: the kernels' WGSL source strings run on the GPU and cannot call Rust; each carries the same curve as its CPU twin

rules.name: blend-mode-enum
rules.description: name blend modes with paged_blend::BlendMode
rules.allowReason: a wire vocabulary that must not change spelling (SceneBlendMode: camelCase, 15 modes, the C-1 wire core deserializes; web-render's two mirror it and web-render has no engine dependency) or a wrapper around paged_blend::BlendMode that adds ABR-only texture modes (paged-psd)

rules.name: fnv-hash
rules.description: hash with fnv1a32 / fnv1a32Utf16 from @paged-media/helpers (TypeScript) and paged_pixel (Rust: fnv1a_64 / fnv1a_64_update / Fnv1a64, fnv1a_32, and the FNV1A_* constants for a mixer built on them; every crate can depend on dependency-free paged-pixel)
rules.allowReason: page.evaluate bodies are serialised into the browser page, which cannot import the helper

rules.name: crc32-polynomial
rules.description: use crc32 from @paged-media/helpers in TypeScript and the crc32fast crate in Rust

rules.name: base64-alphabet
rules.description: use the base64 crate in Rust and platform/shared/helpers in TypeScript

rules.name: bezier-fixed-step
rules.description: sample a cubic at a fixed step count with paged_geom::flatten (cubic_point, sample_cubic, flatten_cubic); the pattern is the Bernstein weight 3(1-t)^2 t
rules.allowReason: f64 samplers in crates below or beside paged-geom's dependency reach: paged-model's winding sits under paged-geom, draw-trace and slide-anim depend on no engine crate, and the image bundle takes no engine geometry; paged_geom::flatten is f32 (cubic_point_f64 serves the engine crates)

rules.name: bezier-kappa
rules.description: the circle's cubic control distance is paged_geom::KAPPA / KAPPA_F32; arcs and ellipses come from kurbo / paged-geom (capability register, geometry)
rules.allowReason: test fixtures that pin a literal, truncated number on purpose (the oracle recordings and the bake fidelity case); the full-precision uses import KAPPA; paged-model's live shapes sit below paged-geom (paged-geom depends on the model), so their pie test pins the constant itself

rules.name: sha2-constants
rules.description: hash with the sha2 crate in Rust and Web Crypto / platform/shared/helpers in TypeScript

rules.name: office-theme-palette
rules.description: take the default Office theme colours from paged_ooxml::drawingml::theme::OFFICE (the OOXML reader) or paged_model::theme::presets (the engine; dml-native holds the two equal)

rules.name: affine-product
rules.description: multiply 2x3 affines with paged_model::affine (f32; paged_geom::affine re-exports it) or paged_geom::affine64 (f64); the pattern is the first term of the product, m[0] * n[0] + m[2] * n[1]
rules.allowReason: test oracles that compute the product independently of the code they check (idml-export and paged-canvas integration tests), and the renderer's text-on-path scale, which multiplies a rotation by a diagonal matrix and is not a general product

rules.name: affine-inverse
rules.description: invert a 2x3 affine with paged_geom::affine::invert_if (f32) or paged_geom::affine64::invert (f64); the pattern is the reciprocal determinant scaling the adjugate

rules.name: affine-ts
rules.description: multiply and apply 2x3 affines with @paged-media/helpers' transform (compose, invert, apply; vector-geometry's applyAffine / composeAffine are its null-tolerant spellings); the patterns are the first term of a product and of an application

rules.name: polygon-coverage-scan
rules.description: fill polygons into 8-bit coverage with paged_kernels::coverage::polygons; the pattern is its sub-scanline position

rules.name: arc-to-cubic
rules.description: approximate a circular arc with cubics (4/3·tan(θ/4)) through paged_geom::ellipse (arc_handle, arc_split, arc_cubics), not a local formula
rules.allowReason: paged-model's live shapes sit below paged-geom (paged-geom depends on the model) and keep their own handle

rules.name: png-encode
rules.description: encode PNG with paged_raster::encode / encode_rgba8_png, not image::PngEncoder
rules.allowReason: decoder tests and a bench that encode their input with an independent encoder (zune-png), so the codec under test is not its own oracle

rules.name: resample-imageops
rules.description: resample pixels with paged-resample (premultiplied), not image::imageops on straight alpha

rules.name: raw-color-input
rules.description: pick colours with panel-kit's ColorInput (the host ColorPicker behind it) or widgets.ColorPicker, not a raw <input type="color">

rules.name: preset-face-shade
rules.description: shade a preset's darken / lighten faces with paged_preset_geom::model::ContourFill (PowerPoint's sRGB shades, read from the live preset; the renderer's fill_paint_shaded applies it), not a module's own item or arithmetic

rules.name: preset-guide-formulas
rules.description: evaluate a DrawingML guide formula (Annex D: `*/`, `+-`, `pin`, `at2`, `cat2`, …) and preset programs with paged_preset_geom (dml_geom re-exports it), not a second evaluator

rules.name: star-anchors
rules.description: star and polygon anchors from platform/shared/vector-geometry (the mirror of paged_model::live_shape)
rules.allowReason: DOM specs that compute the expected points on their own, independently of the code they check (test oracles)

rules.name: homography
rules.description: solve a four-point homography with platform/shared/vector-geometry (TS), the SDK's transform-box (the public SDK cannot import it) or paged_warp::from_quads (Rust); a parity test holds the three to the same numbers

rules.name: photoshop-adjustment-tables
rules.description: evaluate Levels, Curves and an Exposure's offset and gamma as Photoshop's 8-bit tables with paged_image_adjust::tables (one table for the engine's filter stack and paged.image's adjustment layers, engine ADR 1037 amendment 2026-11-11)

rules.name: psd-adjustment-encoding
rules.description: map a Photoshop adjustment layer's encoding (levels and a gamma x100, percentages, gradient locations in 4096ths) onto the engine's RasterOp and back with paged_psd_fx::adjustment; paged.image's adjustment layers hold RasterOps

rules.name: drawingml-crop
rules.description: map a picture's a:srcRect onto its placement and back with dml_native::crop

rules.name: loss-report
rules.description: report what a conversion could not carry with paged_loss::{LossEntry, LossSeverity, LossReport} (TS: LossEntry / LossSeverity from @paged-media/plugin-api), the format's own codes as data

rules.name: pdf-export-loop
rules.description: drive the engine's PDF export session (begin, one exportPdfPage per page, finish, cancel on failure) with the plugin SDK's exportPdfSession, which host.documents.exportPdf and the headless harness run, or the editor client's exportPdf beneath the plugin contract

rules.name: warp-kernels
rules.description: Puppet Warp's outline mesh and ARAP solve and the vector Liquify step are paged-warp's (mesh, puppet::solve_with, liquify, point_map); the vector tools reach them through draw's wasm as vector-tools' WarpKernel
